hoy.vacioCuerpo: Tag a mission with {{modo}} and it will show up here. NIVL shows everything.

form.ayuda: You check it once and it counts in all its modes. With no mode, it counts only in NIVL.

onboarding.pista: NIVL sees everything and is always there. Each mode adds its own arena. You can change them whenever you want.

perfil.ayuda: Every mission adds to your level and to the level of each of its modes.
perfil.vacio: Turn on a mode and every mission with its tag will also add to its level.

hoja.pista: NIVL is always there. What you check shows up in the Today selector and in your mission tags.
